name: vscode-chromium-browser-patch
description: Runs a real Chromium window inside the VS Code integrated browser area through a reversible Windows patch.

commands.title: Chromium Patch: Create Isolated Test Copy
Chromium Patch: Patch This VS Code Installation
Chromium Patch: Restore This VS Code Installation
Chromium Patch: Download Chrome for Testing

chromiumPatch.browserExecutable.description: Absolute path to chrome.exe or msedge.exe. Empty uses an auto-detected browser.

chromiumPatch.profileDirectory.description: Dedicated browser profile directory. Empty uses the extension global storage directory.

chromiumPatch.closeBrowserOnExit.description: Close the hosted browser when the patched VS Code window exits.

scripts.build:helper: dotnet publish native/ChromiumHostHelper.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained false -o runtime/helper
scripts.build: npm run compile && npm run build:helper
